at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0006.title: Money-moving functions need idempotency_key
at-0006.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only idempotency_key=None, check ledgerly.audit.events() for a matching key before any state validation, return the original record without reapplying, and include idempotency_key in the audit entry.
